resources.string: Tap the microphone and speak in Bengali or English
The app was asked to open. Checking what is on screen needs Accessibility, which comes in the next phase.
Microphone access is off. You can still type commands.
I didn\'t hear anything. Tap the microphone and try again.
Speech recognition needs a network connection right now. Check your internet, or turn off \"Prefer offline recognition\" in Settings.
Microphone permission is off. Allow it on the Permissions screen.
The speech service is busy. Wait a moment and try again.
This phone has no speech recognition service. Install or update the Google app, or type your command.
Speech recognition for this language isn\'t installed. Download it in your phone\'s voice settings, or switch language in Settings.
Speech recognition stopped unexpectedly. Try again.
Sathi asks only for what each feature needs. You can change any of these later.
To hear your commands. Sathi listens only while the microphone button is on. Speech is converted to text by your phone\'s speech service, which may use the internet.
Provided by your phone (usually the Google app).
So Sathi can answer aloud in Bengali. Uses your phone\'s text-to-speech engine.
Needed to read the screen, tap, scroll and type for you. Arrives in the next phase.
Needed to find photos, videos and PDFs. Arrives in a later phase.
The language Sathi listens for and replies in. Mixed Bengali and English works in both.
Keeps speech on the phone when an offline language pack is installed. Commands fail if it isn\'t.
Shows each command, plan, action and result on the home screen.

Command understanding, planning and app launching run on this phone. Sathi has no internet permission and sends nothing anywhere itself. Speech-to-text and text-to-speech are done by your phone\'s own services.
